title: CommandFeatures
description: Command-line and script execution schema for the Command modality (Track B). Includes raw text representation for NLP fine-tuning (DistilBERT/RoBERTa) and structured derived metrics.

raw_command_text.description: Raw string of the executed command line, script block, or shell sequence. Serves as the direct input representation for NLP tokenization (DistilBERT/RoBERTa). Not a tabular numeric feature.
raw_command_text.source: Volatility3 windows.cmdline / PowerShell EID 4104 / Sysmon Event ID 1 / bash history

command_length.description: Character length of the primary executed command string

shannon_entropy.description: Calculated Shannon entropy of the command text (high entropy indicates obfuscation/encoding)

is_base64_encoded.description: Binary flag indicating presence of base64 payloads or arguments (-EncodedCommand, -enc, etc.)

has_download_cradle.description: Binary flag indicating download cradles (Net.WebClient, IWR, Invoke-RestMethod, curl, wget)

has_bypass_execution_policy.description: Binary flag indicating PowerShell execution policy bypass flags (-ExecutionPolicy Bypass / -ep bypass)

has_hidden_window.description: Binary flag indicating hidden or non-interactive window execution styles (-WindowStyle Hidden, -w hidden, -noni)

uses_lolbins.description: Binary flag indicating invocation of Living-off-the-Land binaries (certutil, mshta, rundll32, regsvr32, bitsadmin, wmic)

registry_persistence_count.description: Count of command executions modifying Run, RunOnce, Winlogon, or ASEP registry keys
